name: Tidings
overview: The Scriptures present tidings as the proclamation of God's salvation, peace, and reign, often delivered with boldness and joy. Isaiah highlights the messenger who brings good tidings to Zion, encouraging strength and fearlessness in announcing God's presence and salvation. The angels in Luke declare tidings of great joy to all people, emphasizing the glad news of Christ's coming. This theme underscores the Spirit-anointed mission to comfort the brokenhearted and liberate captives, revealing tidings as a divine message of hope and redemption.
